_comment: PROVENANCE MATTERS HERE. Two different things live in this file:
srd     Derived from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 (CC-BY-4.0).
Treasure values and rarity-by-tier follow the SRD's own bands.
authored  Written for this tool. Names, traits, rumours, terrain
weightings. These are my judgement, not anybody's official
content, and the app labels them so.
Monsters in the compendium carry a `type` but no environment tag, so the
terrain table below maps creature TYPE to terrain by hand. It is a data
file rather than code precisely so a DM who disagrees can edit it.

treasure._note: Coin ranges per CR band, as a single hoard. Individual-creature loot is roughly a twentieth of this.

art._note: Flavour for the non-magical half of a hoard, valued in gp.

entries.name: carved bone dice, a set of five
gold locket with a painted portrait
obsidian statuette of a drowned saint

trait: will not sit with their back to a door
has ink on their fingers, always
remembers every name and no faces
want: to be taken seriously, just once
a letter delivered without being read
a child kept out of it
to stop being afraid of the water
secret: they already sold the thing you came for
the body was never found because they moved it
they are being paid to watch you
the debt is theirs, not their brother's
they have been writing to the enemy
they are not who the papers say they are
they know exactly where it is and will not say
they have three days of medicine left

detail: the ceiling is too low by half a foot and everyone stoops
a dog sleeps on the warm hearthstone and will not be moved
the landlord keeps a ledger of who is barred, and it is long
there is a fiddle on the wall nobody is allowed to touch
the ale is poor and the stew is extraordinary
every table is a different height
someone has been carving a whole story into the bar over years
it is far too clean, and nobody explains why

entries: the tax collector has not been seen in nine days
something has been taking the sheep, and it takes only the black ones
the old well is sweet again, which it has not been since the war
there is a light in the tower and the tower has no stairs
a ship came in with nobody aboard and the table still laid
the miller's new wife casts two shadows in candlelight
the road south is fine, whatever the guards tell you
somebody has been paying good coin for very old bones
the priest has stopped taking confession
three children swear the statue moved, and they were not together

trap._note: Save DCs and damage scale with tier; the generator picks a band.

entries.name: Scything blade
entries.effect: a deep cut across the shins

entries.name: Poison needle
entries.effect: the hand goes numb, then the arm

entries.name: Alarm glyph
entries.effect: something distant knows you are here

entries.name: Flooding chamber
entries.effect: cold water to the waist and rising

entries.name: Fire jet
entries.trigger: a pressure plate under the treasure
entries.effect: a column of flame from the wall

_note: Creature TYPE weighted by terrain, because the compendium has no
environment field. Weights are relative, not probabilities. Absent
means never. Edit freely - this is opinion, not rules.
Weighting by creature TYPE alone puts a giant crocodile in the arctic,
which is legal and instantly wrong to anyone reading it out. These are
name fragments excluded per terrain. Crude, authored, and editable -
the alternative is tagging 330 monsters by hand.
